title: I made a browser kung fu game inspired by HK cinema: 40 levels, combos, no health bar
author: MrBenC88
selftext:
Free to play - desktop for best experience! Mobile is supported!

[https://ascend8.vercel.app/?utm\_source=reddit&utm\_medium=social&utm\_campaign=launch&utm\_content=aigamedev](https://ascend8.vercel.app/?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=launch&utm_content=aigamedev)

I built Hidden Dragon for fun, as something to keep my hands busy while watching shows or during dead time. It's packed with references to classic Hong Kong martial arts movies (see how many you can spot).

\- 40 levels built around combo moves and the soundtrack

\- No health bar, so you can play or stop whenever

\- Autoplay mode if you just want to watch it fight

\- An early 1v1 multiplayer mode

\- Language options: Cantonese, Mandarin and English

\- Best on desktop, but works on mobile

It was made with a Cantonese audience in mind. Heads up: some of the AI voice translation isn't perfect, so you might catch a few odd lines

Would love feedback! I think it's pretty fun so far :)  


\---  
Built in 5 days -   
Used opus 5.5 and codex (luna/sol) + eleven labs api for voices/sounds!  


  
Tons of very specific prompt engineering and playtesting!

Currently hoping to collect feedback before my claude usage resets on Sat!

comments.author: Vangrid5857
comments.body: This is a really interesting idea! I like how it mixes Hong Kong kung fu movie influences with combo-based fights, and the autoplay mode is a fun touch too. The early 1v1 multiplayer sounds especially intriguing. I’d love to try it out!

replies.author: MrBenC88
replies.body: Thanks for the kind words. Always happy for you to give it a try and lmk what you think! You can click on the link in the original post to try out (free) and works on mobile + desktop - but desktop for best experience!
